I've upgraded every pinned version that had a newer release and opened **#91** with the changes. `npm run check` passes locally.

**Upgraded:**
- **pit** goes from v0.37.0 to [v0.39.0](https://github.com/cv/pit/releases/tag/v0.39.0), in `.github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml` and `docs/extensions.md`.
- **`actions/create-github-app-token`** goes from v3.3.0 to v3.4.0 in `pi-assistant.yml`. It's still pinned by commit (`f418cff…`).
- **npm dev dependencies:**

  | Package | New version |
  |---|---|
  | `vitest`, `@vitest/coverage-v8` | 5.1.1 |
  | `knip` | 6.46.1 |
  | `@j178/prek` | 0.5.11 |
  | `oxfmt` (exact pin) | 0.79.0 |
  | `oxlint` (exact pin) | 1.94.0 |

  I also ran `npm update`, which updated indirect dependencies in `package-lock.json`.

**Already at the latest, so unchanged:** the pi packages (1.5.2), `@actions/core`, `@actions/github`, `jiti`, `typescript`, `@types/node`, `commitlint`, `jscpd`, `actionlint`, `oxlint-tsgolint`, `@octokit/webhooks-types`, `actions/checkout@v7` and `actions/setup-node@v7`.

**Left alone on purpose:**
- In `docs/extensions.md`, the example that uses `cv/pit#v0.35.1` shows how to set things up with a pit older than 0.36, so it needs to stay old.
- The `v0.35.0` in `src/inputs.test.ts` is only test data.
